> Verdict: MERGE. No open findings from me.
> 
> 9a (OD10, TIDs 1..=31): context n is threads[n-1], and hardware_thread == tid, so this is the same mapping the trap asm used before (it was threads[hw-1] then too). valid_tid guards thread_mut, set_tid, current_thread, thread_exists and setup_redoubt_thread. budget ipc[] and the sched ready array have MAX_THREADS+1 slots, and the walks cover 1..=MAX_THREADS. allocated_threads is a u32, so bit 31 fits. No call in redoubt-sys takes a TID from userspace, so a renumbering cannot be steered by a user. The rv32 shift overflow in find_next_thread is fixed with a checked shift.
> 9b: my r4 P3-1 (try_from in sched::switch) and r5 P3-1 (debug_assert in address_available) are both closed.
> 9c/9d: the debug shell's input side is gone (it was a kernel-side UART reader); no-cruft is now a permanent gate.
> 10c: PNam goes, and nothing reads it.
> 
> Plant (rv64, scratch at b275342c0, reverted and removed): find_free_thread hands out TID 0 (`% (MAX_THREADS + 1)`). thread-limit FAIL, and the kernel's valid_tid assert fires (process.rs:309) rather than letting TID 0 alias the header context. Clean tree: thread-limit, legacy-gone, no-cruft and unsafe-budget all PASS on both widths.
> 
> Whole package, against the angle in my instructions:
> - One decoder: CallFromUMode goes only to redoubt::handle, and legacy-gone sweeps every old number on both widths (planted r4).
> - No legacy path, grant or PID-keyed authority: grants are refused by the loader and the Grnt assert (planted r3). pid-reuse-authority passes. The PID-1 checks that remain identify only the kernel (r4).
> - K5 residuals: the callback that never returns is closed at 7b (r3). Borrowed-quantum direct switches are closed at 7d: SWITCHTO_CALLER and ORIGINAL_PID are deleted, and kmain runs exactly what it picked (r4).
> - Attack cases bite: planted and failing were mem-attack (zeroing), write-only-attack (R11), loader-rejects-grants, legacy-gone and thread-limit.
> - Ratchet: kernel unsafe 13+12+19 = 44 (the target was <= 50, from 54), redoubt-layout 0/0, and redoubt-abi's 52/44 is gone.
